answer: Decaying-capacity leases halve every agent's bandwidth each pulse unless the operator refreshes its quota by burning marble to have the protocol quill sign a lease renewal. Because the quill tracks provenance across the payout graph, refreshing the $j$-th active lease controlled by the same treasury costs $20 \cdot 2^{j-1}$ marble per pulse. An honest solo agent burns 20 marble per pulse to keep full capacity, while a sybil controller keeping $k$ clones alive from one treasury must burn $20(2^k - 1)$ marble every pulse or fund $k$ isolated revenue streams.
